title: Free denominator powers on inverse homogeneous charts
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L$ an invertible $X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and $S=\Gamma_*(X,L)$ its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Let $d>0$, $s\in S_d$, and let $U\subseteq X$ be an open whose underlying set is the nonvanishing locus of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Suppose $g:U\to\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-pc-proj] satisfies the following equations: for every $e>0$, $b\in S_e$, $n\geq0$ and $\xi\in S_{ne}$, on the ambient image $W=U.\iota(g^{-1}(D_+(b)))$, one has $g^\sharp(\xi/b^n)\cdot(b^n)|_W=\xi|_W$. For every $r>0$, $a\in S_r$, open $Q\subseteq U.\iota(g^{-1}(D_+(a)))$ and $n\geq0$, the restriction of the degree-$nr$ component of $a^n$ freely generates $L^{\otimes nr}$ on $Q$: for each open $T\subseteq Q$, multiplication by its restriction gives a bijection $\mathcal O_X(T)\to L^{\otimes nr}(T)$.

proof.text: Import all Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.SectionRingProjPreimageForward and reuse its proved private nonvanishing_power and nonvanishing_of_local_smul lemmas. The former already proves positive-power invariance using tensor nonvanishing, isomorphism transport and homogeneous multiplication; none of those helper declarations is duplicated here.

At x in Q, s is nonvanishing because Q lies in U. Use the imported nonvanishing_power lemma on s^r, and specialize the fraction equation to denominator a, exponent d and numerator s^r. The imported nonvanishing_of_local_smul lemma forces a^d to be nonvanishing. Apply nonvanishing_power again to infer nonvanishing of a, and subsequently of every a^n for n>0.

Apply nonvanishing_section_trivializes to a^n. Its nonvanishing open contains Q. On each W <= Q, the unique-quotient clause gives surjectivity and injectivity of multiplication by the restriction of a^n. For n=0, DirectSum.one_def identifies the section with the tensor-unit generator; restricting isFreeGenerator_one proves the assertion.

theorem sectionRing_chart_denominator_generator
    (X : Scheme.{v}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (d : ℕ) (s : sectionRingGrade L d) (hd : 0 < d) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : (U : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow d) (s.val d))
    (g : U.toScheme ⟶ Proj (sectionRingGrade L))
    (hg : ∀ (e : ℕ) (_he : 0 < e) (t : sectionRingGrade L e)
          (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • e)),
          (show Γ(X, U.ι ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ
              Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val)) from
            g.app (Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val)
            (Proj.awayToSection (sectionRingGrade L) t.val
              (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) t.property n
                ξ.val ξ.property))) •
            (L.tensorPow (n • e)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
              (le_top : U.ι ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val) ≤
                ⊤)).op ((t.val ^ n) (n • e)) =
          (L.tensorPow (n • e)).presheaf.map (homOfLE
            (le_top : U.ι ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) t.val) ≤
              ⊤)).op (ξ.val (n • e)))
    (r : ℕ) (a : sectionRingGrade L r) (hr : 0 < r)
    (Q : X.Opens)
    (hQ : Q ≤ U.ι ''ᵁ (g ⁻¹ᵁ Proj.basicOpen (sectionRingGrade L) a.val)) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, IsFreeGenerator
      ((L.tensorPow (n • r)).presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : Q ≤ ⊤)).op
        ((a.val ^ n) (n • r)))
